player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I attempted to use standard commands like "open" and "put" on objects that likely require the specific custom verbs mentioned in the instructions ("strood", "eucty", "pyell"), or I used the wrong syntax for those verbs. The game explicitly stated these actions are available, yet I treated them as unknown or used them incorrectly (e.g., just typing "strood" without a target). My new strategy is to map the custom verbs to the required actions: I will assume "strood" is used to open containers (like the inchan or cupboard), "eucty" is used to place items inside containers, and "pyell" is used to place items on surfaces (like the aciong). I will retry the sequence: go to the emoust, use "> strood inchan" to open it, then "> eucty oroust in inchan" to place the oroust. Then, I will locate the aciong (likely in the kitchen or emoust) and use "> pyell book on aciong" and "> pyell plate on aciong" to complete the goal. If "on" is not the correct preposition for "pyell", I will try using the verb directly with the object and target (e.g., "> pyell book aciong").
